campaign.title: Change IS_PASSING so that it returns 1 when CLAMP_SCORE(X) is at least 40, otherwise 0. Preserve CLAMP_SCORE and the semantic function-call dependency.

initial.code:
FUNCTION CLAMP_SCORE(X)
  IF (X < 0) THEN
    CLAMP_SCORE = 0
  ELSE
    CLAMP_SCORE = X
  END IF
  IF (X > 50) THEN
    CLAMP_SCORE = 50
  END IF
  CLAMP_SCORE = CLAMP_SCORE
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION IS_PASSING(X)
  IF (CLAMP_SCORE(X) >= 60) THEN
    IS_PASSING = 1
  ELSE
    IS_PASSING = 0
  END IF
  IS_PASSING = IS_PASSING
END FUNCTION
